reportRpcs.name: list_ai_response_reports
reportRpcs.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_ai_response_reports(p_status text DEFAULT 'pending'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_after_created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_after_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_reports jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM private.require_ai_report_reviewer();
  IF p_status IS NULL OR p_status NOT IN ('pending','reviewing','resolved')
      OR p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100
      OR (p_after_created_at IS NULL) <> (p_after_id IS NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_review_request' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'receiptId', r.id, 'surface', r.surface, 'messageId', r.message_id,
    'reason', r.reason, 'reviewStatus', r.review_status,
    'createdAt', r.created_at, 'expiresAt', r.expires_at,
    'ageSeconds', greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch FROM (now() - r.created_at)))),
    'history', r.review_history
  ) ORDER BY r.created_at, r.id), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_reports
  FROM (
    SELECT id, surface, message_id, reason, review_status, created_at, expires_at, review_history
    FROM private.ai_response_reports
    WHERE review_status = p_status AND expires_at > now()
      AND (p_after_created_at IS NULL OR (created_at, id) > (p_after_created_at, p_after_id))
    ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT p_limit
  ) AS r;
  RETURN v_reports;
END
$function$

reportRpcs.name: require_ai_report_reviewer
reportRpcs.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.require_ai_report_reviewer()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  IF v_actor IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM auth.users AS u WHERE u.id = v_actor
      AND u.raw_app_meta_data -> 'herkeys_ai_report_reviewer' = 'true'::jsonb
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reviewer_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN v_actor;
END
$function$

premiumRpcs.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.premium_my_entitlement()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_account uuid := auth.uid(); e public.premium_entitlements%ROWTYPE; v_state text;
BEGIN
  IF v_account IS NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('state', 'unknown'); END IF;
  v_state := public.premium_entitlement_state(v_account);
  SELECT * INTO e FROM public.premium_entitlements WHERE account_id = v_account;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'state', v_state,
    'expiresAt', CASE WHEN v_state LIKE 'premium_%' THEN e.expires_at END,
    'graceExpiresAt', CASE WHEN v_state = 'premium_billing_grace' THEN e.grace_expires_at END,
    'canceled', COALESCE(e.canceled_at IS NOT NULL, false) AND v_state IN ('premium_canceled_active'),
    'needsReconcile', COALESCE(e.needs_reconcile, true),
    'checkedAt', clock_timestamp());
END
$function$
